scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix fpl-backend && npm ci --prefix fpl-frontend && npm ci --prefix fpl-admin-frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix fpl-backend && npm run build --prefix fpl-frontend && npm run build --prefix fpl-admin-frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix fpl-backend && npm run test --prefix fpl-frontend && npm run test --prefix fpl-admin-frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix fpl-frontend && npm run lint --prefix fpl-admin-frontend
